about: Weinrieb Law works from Main Street in Williamsville and explains thirteen stages of a matrimonial case, from the summons to the judgment, which is every stage this directory looks for and more than any other firm in the market. It also publishes four calculators, for maintenance, equitable distribution, pension division and a parenting schedule.

67 reviews at 4.1, two named attorneys, and the only site here that publishes a privacy policy, a disclaimer, a fee page and attorney bios together. It publishes no rate and no retainer figure, so what a client can work out from the calculators is the shape of the settlement rather than the cost of getting there.
